checkpoints.description: [1/2] Skip unused rounded objects at intermediate looks

impact_assessment.benefits: Write rounded objects only for full reports and return slot matches with one Map lookup
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first counter test, interleaved big-tune A/B with identical decisions, full suite and strict gates; revert if not measurable
impact_assessment.risks: contract: identical stop decisions and final reports; dependency: updateDerived signature; concurrency: process-local counter; state: slot/accumulator scoped to one tune
impact_assessment.why: updateDerived built rounded plain objects at every look although the stop guard reads only the Maps, and slotFor looked up the same slot twice

checkpoints.description: Task 'light-derived-slot-1166' abandoned: Rejected light-derived-slot-1166 after measurement: skipping rounded objects at intermediate looks required backfilling all items at full looks and regressed full-tune A/Bs to 0.78x-0.80x with identical decisions; production files restored
[1/2] Return the slot from a single Map lookup

impact_assessment.benefits: Use one Map lookup and create the slot only on a miss, preserving slot identity and accounting
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first counter test, interleaved big-tune A/B with identical decisions, full suite and strict gates; revert if not measurable
impact_assessment.risks: contract: identical slots and measurements; dependency: slot creation order; concurrency: process-local counter; state: slot map
impact_assessment.why: slotFor checked has() and then get() for the same key on every measure

checkpoints.description: Task 'slot-single-lookup-1167' abandoned: Rejected slot-single-lookup-1167 after measurement: replacing has()+get() with one Map lookup in slotFor was neutral-to-regressive across five fourteen-round full-tune A/Bs (median 0.91x) with identical decisions; production files restored
[1/2] Cache balanced-choice paired diffs across sweeps

impact_assessment.benefits: Cache diffs by immutable report pair in the tune context and reuse them in every guard evaluation
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first counter test, interleaved big-tune A/B with identical decisions, full suite and strict gates; revert if not measurable
impact_assessment.risks: contract: identical grouped guard decisions; dependency: stats object identity; concurrency: process-local counter; state: cache scoped to one tune
impact_assessment.why: balancedChoice rebuilt ordered per-item diffs for report pairs that recur across axes and passes now that reports are cached

checkpoints.description: Task 'diff-cache-1168' abandoned: Rejected diff-cache-1168 after measurement: context-level paired-diff cache had only 3 hits per tune and was neutral-to-regressive across five fourteen-round full-tune A/Bs (median 0.94x) with identical decisions; production files restored
[1/2] Skip donor filtering when a cap family has one slot

impact_assessment.benefits: Return missing items directly when no sibling slot can donate, preserving reuse when siblings exist
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first counter test, interleaved big-tune A/B with identical decisions, full suite and strict gates; revert if not measurable
impact_assessment.risks: contract: identical cap reuse and accounting; dependency: capSlots shape; concurrency: process-local counter; state: slot family map
impact_assessment.why: every measure filtered the cap family to find sibling donors although most families have only the current slot

checkpoints.description: Task 'sibling-cap-early-return-1169' abandoned: Rejected sibling-cap-early-return-1169 after measurement: skipping donor filtering for lone cap slots was neutral-to-regressive across five fourteen-round full-tune A/Bs (median 0.91x) with identical decisions; production files restored
[1/2] Memoize sweep base keys by current object

impact_assessment.benefits: Cache the derived base key on the current object identity and reuse it across sweeps
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first counter test, interleaved big-tune A/B with identical decisions, full suite and strict gates; revert if not measurable
impact_assessment.risks: contract: identical cache keys and decisions; dependency: current object identity; concurrency: process-local counter; state: cache scoped to one tune
impact_assessment.why: each sweep re-stringified the same current and forced settings although current is the same object until an axis changes it

checkpoints.description: Task 'settings-key-memo-1170' abandoned: Rejected settings-key-memo-1170 after measurement: memoizing sweep base keys regressed two fourteen-round full-tune A/Bs (0.81x and 0.79x) with identical decisions because current objects change often and the WeakMap added overhead; production files restored
[1/2] Reuse grouped guard stats across sweeps

impact_assessment.benefits: Cache grouped guard entries by rung, incumbent report and candidate report, reusing identical guard evidence
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first counter test, interleaved big-tune A/B with identical decisions, full suite and strict gates; revert if not measurable
impact_assessment.risks: contract: identical guard decisions; dependency: report object identity and rung array; concurrency: process-local counter; state: cache scoped to one tune
impact_assessment.why: balancedChoice rebuilt per-view rates and evidence for report pairs that recur now that reports are cached

checkpoints.description: Task 'group-guard-cache-1171' abandoned: Rejected group-guard-cache-1171 after measurement: tune-wide grouped-guard cache had only 1 hit per big tune and regressed full-tune A/Bs to 0.82x and 0.92x with identical decisions; production files restored
[1/2] Reuse costDelta results across sweeps

impact_assessment.benefits: Cache costDelta by immutable report pair, tie band and cost field within one tune
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first counter test, interleaved big-tune A/B with identical decisions, full suite and strict gates; revert if not measurable
impact_assessment.risks: contract: identical selection decisions; dependency: report object identity; concurrency: process-local counter; state: cache scoped to one tune
impact_assessment.why: choose recomputed per-item cost differences for report pairs that recur now that reports are cached

checkpoints.description: Task 'cost-delta-cache-1172' abandoned: Rejected cost-delta-cache-1172 after measurement: tune-wide costDelta cache had only 1 hit per big tune and was neutral-to-regressive across four full-tune A/Bs (median 0.95x) with identical decisions; production files restored
[1/2] Reuse public report summaries across sweeps

impact_assessment.benefits: Cache publicStats by immutable stats object identity within one tune and reuse identical summaries
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first counter test, interleaved big-tune A/B with identical decisions, full suite and strict gates; revert if not measurable
impact_assessment.risks: contract: identical report records; dependency: stats object identity; concurrency: process-local counter; state: cache scoped to one tune
impact_assessment.why: record.rungs rebuilt the same public summary for cached stats objects that recur across axes and passes

checkpoints.description: Task 'public-stats-reuse-1173' abandoned: Rejected public-stats-reuse-1173 after measurement: caching public summaries regressed two fourteen-round full-tune A/Bs (0.81x and 0.77x) with identical decisions because the spread into candidate records still allocates; production files restored
[1/2] Cache view membership sets and count with loops

impact_assessment.benefits: Build one Set per view per sweep and count majority passes with a plain loop
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first counter test, interleaved big-tune A/B with identical decisions, full suite and strict gates; revert if not measurable
impact_assessment.risks: contract: identical grouped evidence and decisions; dependency: group arrays stable per sweep; concurrency: process-local counter; state: sets scoped to one guard call
impact_assessment.why: groupEvidence rebuilt a Set per view per candidate and groupRate allocated a filtered array to count passes

checkpoints.description: Task 'group-evidence-loop-1174' abandoned: Rejected group-evidence-loop-1174 after measurement: caching six-item view Sets in a WeakMap regressed two fourteen-round full-tune A/Bs (0.80x and 0.77x) with identical decisions; groupRate was already a loop; production files restored
[1/2] Replace rung snapshots with copy-on-write derived containers

impact_assessment.benefits: Create fresh derived containers per rung so finalize can return them directly without a second copy
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first counter test, interleaved big-tune A/B with identical decisions, full suite and strict gates; revert if not measurable
impact_assessment.risks: contract: identical rung reports and decisions; dependency: accumulator state shape; concurrency: process-local counter; state: accumulator scoped to one sweep
impact_assessment.why: each rung copied four per-item containers after mutating shared ones, doubling the write work across rungs

checkpoints.description: Task 'rung-copy-on-write-1175' abandoned: Rejected rung-copy-on-write-1175 after measurement: copy-on-write derived containers regressed four fourteen-round full-tune A/Bs (0.82x to 0.89x) with identical decisions; production files restored
